title: HÖGÖN Umbrella
description: HÖGÖN Umbrella, hanging, white. This hanging umbrella lets you enjoy a sunny day in the shade, without having a pole that blocks your view or gets in the way. And if the canopy gets dirty, it’s easy to remove it from the frame and wash.
features: The umbrella does not provide protection against reflected or scattered solar ultraviolet radiation.
Possible to separate for recycling or energy recovery if available in your community.
To be completed with IGGÖN sand bag for umbrella base, sold separately (or with 4 concrete slabs, min. size 19⅝x19⅝", total weight min. 198.4 lbs).
May be completed with TOSTERÖ umbrella cover (86⅝").
materialAndCare: Pole/ Ribs: Steel, Polyester powder coating; Base: Galvanized steel, Polyester powder coating; Fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled)
